article.title: Constant Contact公布Catalyst，小企可審批AI擬定的活動
article.summary: Constant Contact公布面向小企的Catalyst，工具可按企業的線上內容擬定計劃，並交由負責人審稿。
highlights: 公司列出電郵、社交平台及短訊等支援方向。
現階段可登記早期使用計劃。
article.why: 小企可先檢查AI是否能維持跨渠道語氣，再決定哪些執行步驟適合交給工具。
article.next_step: 挑一個促銷主題，逐項核對電郵和社交文案的日期、優惠及發送對象。
article.detail: 按Constant Contact公告，Catalyst會參考企業的線上內容，草擬分項計劃及跨渠道文案。企業負責人審批內容後，工具才執行相關工作。現階段提供早期使用計劃；安排試點時，可先為活動設定一名批准人，並逐一核對優惠條件、品牌語氣及發送名單。
article.title_en: Constant Contact announces Catalyst with small-business approval for AI campaigns
article.summary_en: Constant Contact announced Catalyst for small businesses. It can draft a plan from a business's online presence and send content for review.
highlights_en: The company describes channels including email, social and SMS.
Businesses can register for early access.
article.why_en: Small teams can check tone across channels before deciding which execution steps to delegate.
article.next_step_en: Choose one promotion and check the dates, offer and audience in draft email and social copy.
article.detail_en: Constant Contact says Catalyst reviews a business's online presence and drafts a plan and copy across channels. A person approves content before the tool executes related work. Access is through an early programme. For a pilot, assign an approver and check offer terms, brand tone and the recipient list.
